fe4635e6019e68eea731accd36d41e5cb6995725.text: {"verdict":"accept","reasons":["The plan uses the pinned demo_prices@1 dataset throughout and confirms it with a source review.","It searches the lookback grid (5–250, inside the strategy's allowed range) on the train window only.
